geometric_squareclass.reason: Dplus has two simple zeros, so its divisor has odd valuations at r_plus and r_minus.
geometric_squareclass.uniqueness_scope: unique in Qbar(t)^*/Qbar(t)^{*2} with this prescribed finite odd-valuation support, up to constants which are squares over Qbar

semantic_boundary.what_is_certified: the named half-divisor pushes to the base principal divisor of Dplus and therefore supplies the only geometrically nontrivial base squareclass compatible with its finite support
semantic_boundary.arithmetic_partial_norm_squareclass_2: retained separately; it cannot replace the geometric squareclass because constants die over Qbar
